headlines.text: Back on this day in 2025, Adam Page vs. Jon Moxley fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Heavyweight Title in an Everyone Banned From Ringside match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.61 ? a war that left everything in the ring. Page retained the AEW World Title over Moxley with everyone banned from ringside, one night before Darby Allin's interference proved decisive backstage.

Back on this day in 2026, The Demand vs. The Rascalz clashed for the AEW World Trios Titles, appearing on Collision, rated 7.26 ? a match that delivered. It was the first title opportunity of The Rascalz's career. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
It was 2025 when Mark Briscoe vs. Ricochet closed out Dynamite, rated 6.89 in a hard-fought men's division clash.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2025, when The Young Bucks vs. The Outrunners met in a Tournament Match, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 7.43 ? a good, competitive contest.
